## Fetch Codebase Exploration - Complete Analysis

**Multi-language, Full-Stack Project:**

- **Test Framework:** Vitest + TypeScript

- fetch-app (Node/TS): v0.0.96 - "Fetch - WhatsApp AI Assistant"
- manager (Go): github.com/fetch/manager with Bubble Tea + Charmbracelet libs for TUI

**Tech Stack Dependencies:**
- WhatsApp: whatsapp-web.js v1.34.6
- AI: OpenAI v6.18.0, OpenRouter
- Docker: dockerode v4.0.9
- Web scraping: jsdom, turndown, @mozilla/readability
- Database: better-sqlite3
- Validation: Zod v4.3.6
- Optional channels: Discord.js, Telegraf, Slack Bolt

| Method | Route | Protection | Purpose |
|--------|-------|-----------|---------|
| GET | /api/status | None | Bridge status + metrics (JSON) |
| GET | /api/health | None | Lightweight health check for Go TUI |
| POST | /api/logout | Admin token | Disconnect WhatsApp |
| POST | /api/whatsapp/start | Admin token | Start WhatsApp bridge |
| POST | /api/whatsapp/restart | Admin token | Restart WhatsApp bridge |
| POST | /api/config/reload | Admin token | Hot-reload .env file |
| GET | /api/sessions | Admin token | List all sessions (paginated) |
| GET | /api/sessions/:id | Admin token | Get single session details |
| DELETE | /api/sessions/:id | Admin token | Delete session |
| POST | /api/sessions/:id/clear | Admin token | Clear session history |
| GET | /docs/* | None | Static documentation site |
| GET | / | None | Redirect to /docs/ |

**Authentication:** Bearer token in `Authorization: Bearer {ADMIN_TOKEN}` header (optional if ADMIN_TOKEN unset)

**Response Format:** JSON with CORS headers enabled (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`)

---

- Entry point: `/home/traves/Development/Fetch/fetch-app/src/index.ts`
- Creates runtime with injectable `exit()` for testability
- Calls `startStatusServer()` immediately (before WhatsApp bridge)
- Status server stays alive in "setup mode" if WhatsApp not connected
- Listens on port 8765 at address 0.0.0.0
- Watches .env file for auto-reload (interval: 1000ms)

**Shutdown Hooks:** Graceful shutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM via process handlers

# Fetch - Docker Compose Configuration
# Dual-container architecture: Bridge (Brain) + Kennel (Muscle)

services:
  # The Bridge - WhatsApp orchestration layer
  fetch-bridge:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: fetch-app/Dockerfile
    container_name: fetch-bridge
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD", "curl", "-sf", "http://localhost:8765/api/status" ]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    env_file:
      - .env
    # ─── Pipeline Tuning (uncomment to override defaults) ─────
    # environment:
    #   # Context Window
    #   - FETCH_HISTORY_WINDOW=20              # Messages in sliding window
    #   - FETCH_COMPACTION_THRESHOLD=40        # Compact when messages exceed this
    #   # Agent LLM
    #   - FETCH_CHAT_MAX_TOKENS=300            # Token budget for chat responses
    #   - FETCH_TOOL_MAX_TOKENS=500            # Token budget for tool responses
    #   - FETCH_CHAT_TEMPERATURE=0.7           # Chat creativity (0.0-1.0)
    #   - FETCH_TOOL_TEMPERATURE=0.3           # Tool precision (0.0-1.0)
    #   - FETCH_MAX_TOOL_CALLS=5               # Tool call rounds per message
    #   # Rate Limiting
    #   - FETCH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=30              # Requests per window
    #   - FETCH_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW=60000        # Window duration (ms)
    #   # Timeouts
    #   - FETCH_TASK_TIMEOUT=300000            # Task execution (ms)
    #   - FETCH_HARNESS_TIMEOUT=300000         # AI harness (ms)
    ports:
      # Status API for Go TUI (also serves docs)
      - "8765:8765"
    volumes:
      # Persistent data (WhatsApp auth, task database)
      - ./data:/app/data
      # Configuration file (hot-reload via POST /api/config/reload)
      - ./.env:/app/.env:ro
      # Documentation site (live-reload without image rebuild)
      - ./docs:/app/docs:ro
      # Docker socket for controlling Kennel
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      # Shared workspace for file operations
      - ./workspace:/workspace
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G
          cpus: '2.0'
    depends_on:
      - fetch-kennel
    networks:
      - fetch-network

  # The Kennel - AI CLI execution sandbox
  fetch-kennel:
    build:
      context: ./kennel
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: fetch-kennel
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD-SHELL", "command -v git >/dev/null && command -v node >/dev/null && test -d /workspace" ]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      # GH_TOKEN overrides keyring-based auth inside container
      # gh CLI and git both respect this env var
      - GH_TOKEN=${GH_TOKEN}
      - OPENCODE_API_KEY=${OPENCODE_API_KEY:-}
      - CODEX_API_KEY=${CODEX_API_KEY:-}
      - OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
      - OPENROUTER_API_KEY=${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}
      # ─── Network Firewall ──────────────────────────────────
      - FIREWALL_ENABLED=${FIREWALL_ENABLED:-false}
      - FIREWALL_WHITELIST=${FIREWALL_WHITELIST:-}
    volumes:
      # Shared workspace for code operations
      - ./workspace:/workspace
      # CLI Authentication (mounted from host, read-only)
      # Only mount directories that exist on host
      - ~/.config/gh:/root/.config/gh
      - ~/.config/claude-code:/root/.config/claude-code
      - ~/.claude:/root/.claude
      - ~/.gemini:/root/.gemini
      - ~/.config/opencode:/root/.config/opencode
      - ~/.codex:/root/.codex
    working_dir: /workspace
    # Keep container running for exec commands
    command: [ "tail", "-f", "/dev/null" ]
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "3"
    networks:
      - fetch-network
    # ─── Security ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    # NET_ADMIN required for iptables-based egress firewall
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    cap_drop:
      - SYS_ADMIN
      - SYS_PTRACE
      - NET_RAW
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=256m,noexec,nosuid
      - /root:size=128m
    pids_limit: 512
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G
          cpus: '2'

  # SearXNG - Self-hosted meta search engine (free, private)
  searxng:
    image: searxng/searxng:latest
    container_name: fetch-searxng
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8888:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./config/searxng:/etc/searxng
    environment:
      - SEARXNG_BASE_URL=http://searxng:8080/
    networks:
      - fetch-network
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "50m"
        max-file: "3"
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '1'

networks:
  fetch-network:
    driver: bridge
